title: Queue scan performance telemetry and baseline
summary: Add queue scan phase telemetry, cache/fallback evidence, candidate and directory counts, first-processing-stage timing, and repeatable five-run queue source-inventory baselines.
reason: Establish reconciled performance evidence before changing discovery, processed-index caching, or launch behavior so later optimization PRs can prove equivalent membership and measurable latency improvement.
behavior_before: Queue scan status exposed counts and lifecycle state but no reconciled phase timings, cache/fallback decisions, directory counts, or repeatable queue benchmark scenario.
behavior_after: Queue scan and queue-plan artifacts expose additive timing and decision evidence; pipeline progress records first processing-stage entry; the benchmark tool records five-run cold/full and warm/normal queue inventory median and p95 results without mutating operator media.
tests_added: Python queue scan telemetry reconciliation assertions
Python five-run queue benchmark fingerprint assertions
PowerShell queue snapshot telemetry persistence contract check
manual_validation: Generated disposable 400-candidate queue baseline completed with five cold/full and five warm/normal samples; fingerprints matched and source_mutation=false.
Adversarial review confirmed telemetry is additive, fallback evidence is read-only, and no FFmpeg, publish, scratch, or source mutation policy changed.
Python queue/tooling tests: 8 passed; adjacent queue facade/library API tests: 15 passed; Ruff and targeted mypy passed.
PowerShell queue engine, library index cache, contract schema, and full active reliability regression checks passed.
Generated summary and project-index freshness checks passed for 2,331 source files; strict worktree change-packet coverage passed.
rollback_plan: Revert this change packet's commit. Existing readers ignore the additive fields, and removing the benchmark scenario and telemetry leaves the prior queue discovery and execution behavior unchanged.
notes: Python impact: additive observability fields and benchmark tooling only; no queue membership or media-processing policy is changed. The documented context_slice fallback was unavailable on origin/main, so generated maps and bounded source/test reads were used. Representative real-media validation is not required for this telemetry-only PR; PRs 4 and 5 retain that gate.
